text_block_list.text:
I rushed Katsuragi Ace to the infirmary 
after she got injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, damn it! I blew it...! Why did it have 
to happen now, of all times...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, please, let me keep training! I was 
just about to grasp something...!"
choice_data_list:
If you push yourself too hard, you won't 
be able to grasp it either.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's true. What's the point of 
falling off a cliff just to take a step 
toward your dream?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm wide awake now. ...I still have a long 
way to go...

She clenched her fist as she spoke, so 
tightly that her nails dug into her skin.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I owe you one...! I definitely 
won't do anything dangerous. I promise!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, totally doable. If it's just an 
easy run, it's no sweat at a—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more... I was so close! The 
wall was right there in front of me!!

I hurried her to the infirmary after her 
injury worsened. Afterwards, it took quite 
a while before she could return...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No! If I just dash and build up momentum, 
maybe it'll work out...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I-I know! I get it already! Trainer, your 
eyes look terrifying, y'know!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just an easy breeze-through today! That 
works, right?

Katsuragi Ace's rehab progressed smoothly, 
and she made a full recovery much faster 
than expected!
